description: Niveau d'accessibilité des trottoirs pour les personnes à mobilité réduite – Centre-ville de Biarritz is a dataset listed in Mairie de Biarritz : Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville de Biarritz - Direction Solidarités Familles - Service Politiques sociales et inclusives. Ce jeu de données cartographie l'accessibilité des trottoirs pour les personnes à mobilité réduite (PMR), en utilisant un système de codage à quatre couleurs inspiré des pistes de ski. Coverage: Biarritz. The portal files it under Mobilité, Déplacements. Its keywords are Accessibilité, Handicap, trottoir, mobilité, personnes à mobilité réduite, PMR. The portal shows 63 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-05-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-biarritz-fr-portal.
